nodes.name: Fetch insights
nodes.notes: Chained after Fetch actions rather than run beside it. Two branches into one node make that node execute twice in n8n, which would ingest every document twice.

nodes.name: Cognee: Add Data
nodes.notes: Plain HTTP against Cognee's REST API rather than the n8n-nodes-cognee community node: that node is unverified, and n8n Cloud installs verified nodes only. The managed platform rejects the batched {data: [...]} shape on /add, so this posts one document per call to /add_text - no executeOnce, the node runs once per incoming item. Needs a Header Auth credential named 'Cognee API' - try Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer <key>; if the tenant answers 401, edit the credential to Name: X-Api-Key, Value: <bare key>.

nodes.name: Cognee: Cognify
nodes.notes: Builds the knowledge graph: entities, relationships, chunks and embeddings. Runs once per sync, not once per document.

nodes.name: Let the graph settle
nodes.notes: Cognify can answer 'accepted' and keep building in the background. Searching immediately would read an empty graph and trip the assertion below for the wrong reason, and a false alarm is worse than a slow sync.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'Which customers returned after the last win-back offer, and what did they buy?', searchType: 'GRAPH_COMPLETION', search_type: 'GRAPH_COMPLETION', datasets: ['munshiji_' + ($vars.MUNSHIJI_MERCHANT_ID || 'default')], datasetName: 'munshiji_' + ($vars.MUNSHIJI_MERCHANT_ID || 'default'), top_k: 10, topK: 10 }) }}

nodes.name: Cognee: Search (verify)
nodes.notes: Both key spellings go out on purpose: Cognee releases have used camelCase and snake_case for the same three fields, and a server ignores what it does not know.
